title: Noor and the Letter
author: I. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Cyrus Blackwood, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
